{{Quote|Trust me. We're getting that spice!|Turk Falso to Barb Mentir|audio=WereGettingThatSpice-TheGunganGeneral.flac|<ref name="TGG">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>}}
'''Turk Falso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] member of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]].

==Biography==
Once a member of a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]]<ref name="tcwce" />, Turk Falso was part of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]],<ref name="DC" /> despite never liking taking orders from [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]].<ref name="tcwce" /> At some point around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref>Since {{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}} depicts [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] as still alive, this short story must take place before {{TCW|The Gungan General}}.</ref> Turk Falso, alongside Hondo Ohnaka and [[Piit/Legends|Piit]], sabotaged the ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' to kidnap several of the liner's passengers.<ref name="Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>

===Capture of Dooku===
[[File:TurkFalso.png|thumb|left|180px|Turk Falso]]
Ohnaka's gang found [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], after he escaped from a [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|battle]] between him and two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Ohnaka offered Dooku passage to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], a planet six [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] away. When Dooku arrived on Florrum, he was captured by the pirates. Ohnaka contacted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and demanded the Republic to pay 1,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in exchange for the captured Count. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] Kenobi and Skywalker were tasked to go to Florrum and confirm if the pirates did indeed capture Dooku. Upon their arrival, Falso scanned them with a [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] for any hidden weapons and lead them to his leader. They met Ohnaka and saw Dooku locked up in a [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]] in his cell. Kenobi contacted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to confirm the capture of Dooku. Palpatine sent [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] on a [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|ransom mission]]. Later Falso invited Kenobi and Skywalker to join them in a Weequay banquet.<ref name="DC">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>

===Deception and death===
Falso tried to double cross his [[Captain/Legends|captain]], Hondo Ohnaka, the leader of a pirate gang on the backwater [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Florrum to steal the spice [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] for himself. He ordered a fellow pirate, [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]] to shoot down [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|the ship]] carrying the spice in order to get it. His plan worked, partially, but the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and Jar Jar Binks survived the crash, killing only the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] and Kharrus. After he heard that there were possible survivors from Mentir, he went to get the spice himself along with some other [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] utilizing [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|swoop bikes]]. Falso stole the spice from the wreckage of the ship located in the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]], but the surviving clones and Jar Jar got it back after chasing Falso and his gang by riding on [[Skalder/Legends|skalders]], creatures native to Florrum.<ref name="TGG" />

[[File:Falso_choked.png|thumb|right|250px|Falso being [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choked]] by Count Dooku]]
After returning to the pirate base, Falso said to Ohnaka that the Republic hadn't send the spice, but an army. He asked if he could send [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|tanks]] to destroy the army. Ohnaka gave him permission, but Falso's plan failed. One of the tanks was accidentally destroyed by Jar Jar who rammed it into one of the power lines to the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate outpost]]. The remaining two tanks were attacked by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and the clone troopers and both tanks were captured. They used them to quickly go to Ohnaka's pirate base and get in unnoticed. Falso was about to flee in a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] knowing that Ohnaka would figure out his betrayal, when he was suddenly choked and lifted into the air by an unseen force. As Mentir watched, Count Dooku, who escaped from the pirate prison during the power loss in the base, emerged from the shadows and manipulated Falso into shooting the other pirate in the chest before crushing his throat with the Force and killing him. Dooku then escaped Florrum in the Weequay [[Unidentified Flarestar-class attack shuttle (Ohnaka Gang)/Legends|saucer craft]] which the two pirates were planning to escape in.<ref name="TGG" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That nitwit couldn't kill a nuna. He depends on me for that.|Turk Falso describing Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="TGG" />}}
Falso was a skilled liar and manipulator who made it as far as Hondo's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. He gained Ohnaka's trust, which he used to operate on his own inside Ohnaka's gang. Falso thought that Hondo was weak, even saying to Mentir that "Hondo couldn't kill a [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]]". His lies eventually got him [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TGG" />

Falso was notable for sporting, alongside [[Boot/Legends|boots]] taken from a rich captive,<ref name="tcwce" /> a colorful bandanna<ref name="DC" /> from his days in a swoop gang.<ref name="tcwce" />

==Behind the scenes==
Falso was voiced by [[Greg Ellis]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] animated series.<ref name="DC" />
